SALARYSTRUCTURE.description: Employee fixed agreed master monthly CTC package and component structure breakup (Gross_Salary, Basic, HRA, Conveyance, Medical, Washing, Uniform, Other) with revision history. Use this table when user asks for 'salary structure', 'CTC package', 'fixed salary breakup', or 'agreed CTC'.
queryRules: Use SALARYSTRUCTURE when the question is about: 'salary structure', 'CTC breakup', 'fixed CTC', 'agreed package', 'basic HRA structure', or 'current salary structure'.
Filter by employee code using Emp_Code = @empCode (e.g. Emp_Code = '19001162').
Always sort by Effective_date DESC to get the latest active salary structure revision (ORDER BY Effective_date DESC).

Fixed Gross CTC package is in Gross_Salary. Fixed Basic is in Basic. Fixed HRA is in HRA. Conveyance is in Conveyance. Medical is in Medical. Washing is in Washing. Uniform is in Uniform. Other allowances is in Other.

CRITICAL DISTINCTION: For actual monthly earned salary, payslips, or specific month payout (e.g. 'April 2026 me kitni salary mili', 'net payable', 'actual earned'), query SALARYFILE table, NOT SALARYSTRUCTURE.

SALARYFILE.description: Comprehensive monthly processed payroll register storing fixed structure pay, actual earned components (Gross_Earn, Basic_Earn, HRA_Earn, etc.), statutory & advance deductions (PF, ESIC, TDS, Loan, Advance, P1P2_DED), attendance day counts (Present_days, Monthdays, Absent, Leave), designation snapshot (Desig_Desc), and final net payable salary (Final_Payment).
queryRules: Filter by specific month using SalMnth = @month (1-12) or SalMnth = @monthName (e.g. SalMnth = 4 for April).
Filter by specific year using salyear = @year (e.g. salyear = 2026).
Filter by employee using Emp_Code = @empCode (e.g. Emp_Code = '19001162').
Join with EMPLOYEEMASTER on SALARYFILE.Emp_Code = EMPLOYEEMASTER.EMPCODE.
Join with Misc_Mst for branch name on Misc_Mst.Misc_Code = SALARYFILE.Loc_Code AND Misc_Mst.Misc_Type = 85.
Net Payable Salary is in Final_Payment.
Actual Earned Gross Salary is in Gross_Earn (or Total_Earn).
Fixed Gross Package is in Gross (or Total).
Actual worked present days count is in Present_days. Total calendar days is in Monthdays. Absent days is in ABSENTVALUE / Off_days.
Employee designation snapshot in payroll is in Desig_Desc.

attendancetable.displayName: Daily Employee Attendance & Shift Punch Register
attendancetable.description: Core daily attendance and shift punch transaction table recording day-by-day employee attendance status (Present, Absent, Weekly Off, Holiday, Leave Without Pay, Paid Leaves), biometric/manual in-out punches, shift timings, overtime, and approval workflows.
queryRules: CRITICAL: ALWAYS use COUNT(DISTINCT Emp_Code) when calculating total present, absent, weekly off, or working employees count. NEVER use COUNT(*) because single employees can have multiple punch logs/records for the same date.
CRITICAL: ALWAYS use SELECT DISTINCT A.Emp_Code, E.EMPNAME ... or GROUP BY A.Emp_Code, E.EMPFIRSTNAME, E.EMPLASTNAME when listing employees to prevent duplicate employee rows.
Presence Filter: For Present employees ('present', 'aaye the', 'duty', 'hazir'), filter by UPPER(flag) = 'P'.

Absence & Non-Working Filter: Pure Absent is UPPER(flag) = 'A'. Combined Non-Working (Absent + Weekly Off) is (UPPER(flag) = 'A' OR UPPER(flag) = 'WO'). When answering absent questions, always report both Pure Absent (flag='A') and Total Not Working (flag='A' OR flag='WO') with exact breakdown.
Weekly Off Filter: For Weekly Off / Weakly Off ('weekly off', 'weakly off', 'week off', 'weak off', 'weekoff', 'sunday', 'itwar'), filter by UPPER(flag) = 'WO'.
Holiday Filter: For Holidays ('holiday', 'tyohar', 'festival'), filter by (UPPER(flag) = 'H' OR UPPER(status) = 'H').
Half Day Filter: For Half Day ('half day', 'halfday', 'aadha din', 'HD'), filter by (UPPER(flag) = 'HD' OR UPPER(status) = 'HD').
Leave Filter: For Leaves ('leave', 'CL', 'SL', 'PL', 'LWP', 'EL', 'ML'), filter by (UPPER(flag) IN ('CL', 'SL', 'PL', 'LWP', 'EL', 'ML') OR UPPER(status) IN ('CL', 'SL', 'PL', 'LWP', 'EL', 'ML')).
Filter by specific date using CONVERT(date, dateoffice) = 'YYYY-MM-DD' or CAST(dateoffice AS DATE) = 'YYYY-MM-DD' (e.g. CONVERT(date, dateoffice) = '2025-10-21').
Filter by date range using dateoffice BETWEEN 'YYYY-MM-DD' AND 'YYYY-MM-DD' or MONTH(dateoffice) = @month AND YEAR(dateoffice) = @year.
Join with EMPLOYEEMASTER using attendancetable.Emp_Code = EMPLOYEEMASTER.EMPCODE (or attendancetable.empcode = EMPLOYEEMASTER.EMPCODE).
Always filter by Export_Type = @compcode (Company ID / Multi-tenant isolation).
Punch In/Out Columns: in1 (First In Time), out1 (First Out Time), in2 (Second In Time), out2 (Second Out Time), in1mannual/out1mannual (Manual punches).
Working & Overtime Hours: hoursworked (Total Worked Hours), exclunchhours (Worked Hours Excl. Lunch), otduration (Overtime Duration), otamount (Overtime Pay Amount), totallosshrs (Total Lost Hours).
Punctuality Tracking: latearrival (Late Arrival Duration), earlydeparture (Early Departure Duration), earlyarrival (Early Arrival), lunchearlydeparture, lunchlatearrival.
